result.markdown:
# Transport Link Fiber Cut in Sfax

- **Classification:** incident
- **Root cause:** transport_failure at `LNK-SFX-01-B`
- **Confidence:** medium (Direct alarms match the timing, topology links children to the fiber, and changes/maintenance were ruled out via tool checks.)
- **Impact:** 2026-09-27 08:04 to 2026-09-27 10:24
- **Cause time:** 2026-09-27 08:04
- **Affected:** S-SFX-005, S-SFX-008, S-SFX-010

## Summary

Fiber cut on transport link LNK-SFX-01-B caused simultaneous site down alarms on S-SFX-005, S-SFX-008, and S-SFX-010.

Traffic dropped across three sites in Sfax due to simultaneous site outages lasting about two hours.

## Timeline

- 2026-09-27 08:00: Region-level traffic alert ALR-0033 started. [ALR-0033]
- 2026-09-27 08:04: Critical SITE_DOWN alarms raised on sites S-SFX-005, S-SFX-008, and S-SFX-010. [ALM-000550, ALM-000551, ALM-000552]
- 2026-09-27 10:23: SITE_DOWN alarms cleared on S-SFX-005 and S-SFX-008. [ALM-000550, ALM-000552]
- 2026-09-27 10:24: SITE_DOWN alarm cleared on S-SFX-010. [ALM-000551]
- 2026-09-27 10:30: Region-level traffic alert ALR-0033 ended. [ALR-0033]

## Evidence

- Sites S-SFX-005, S-SFX-008, and S-SFX-010 went down simultaneously at 2026-09-27 08:04. [ALM-000550, ALM-000551, ALM-000552]
- All affected sites share the fiber transport link LNK-SFX-01-B and aggregate router AGG-SFX-01. [T3, S-SFX-005]
- No configuration changes were recorded on the sites or their parents between 2026-09-27 06:00 and 12:00. [T4]
- No maintenance windows were scheduled on the affected nodes and parents during the incident window. [T6]

## Hypotheses

1. **transport_failure** at LNK-SFX-01-B: confirmed. Simultaneous site drops match the exact child topology of transport link LNK-SFX-01-B with no other competing causes. [T3, ALM-000550, RB-FIBER-CUT#01]
2. **bad_change**: rejected. Tool checks confirmed zero changes occurred on the affected nodes and ancestors during the incident window. [T4]

## Ruled out

- T4: Changes check returned no changes during the incident window, ruling out bad configuration changes.
- T6: Maintenance check confirmed no maintenance windows were active for these nodes.
- ALR-0034: This alert occurred on 2026-09-28 for site S-SFX-003, which is outside the scope and timeframe of yesterday morning's incident.

## Recommended actions

- Inspect fiber link LNK-SFX-01-B for physical damage or cuts.
- Verify splicing logs and attenuation metrics on LNK-SFX-01-B.

truth.notes: trap=missing_alarm; Fibre cut on LNK-SFX-01-B; all 3 downstream sites lost service until repair. The LINK_LOS alarm was never raised: only SITE_DOWN alarms on the sites exist. Trap: there is no alarm on LNK-SFX-01-B, only 3 SITE_DOWN alarms on sites, so a hasty investigator names a site or a set of independent site faults. Settled by: get_topology shows that the 3 sites share the parent LNK-SFX-01-B and that nothing else hangs under it; they went down in the same minute and sites on sibling links stayed up, so the shared link is the one cause.
